brief:
Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay, the South African human rights lawyer and international jurist, discussed the International Criminal Court's role in addressing allegations of war crimes, according to Democracy Now! The acclaimed legal expert addressed the conflict in Gaza and the treatment of rape as a war crime in international law.

Pillay's work spans decades of human rights advocacy and judicial service. Her recognition with the Nobel Peace Prize reflects her contributions to international justice and her efforts to hold accountable those responsible for atrocities.
dek: We speak with the acclaimed South African human rights lawyer and international jurist Navi Pillay, who was awarded this year’s Nobel Peace Prize.
title: Nobel laureate Navi Pillay discusses ICC, Gaza war crimes
